items.html: However, it did not come down there because of a flaw in it, as it has been explained above that the breaking was in the vessels and not in the lights. If its descent was there due to a flaw, it would be right to attribute the cancelation to the lights, as we similarly attributed the cancelation to the posterior vessels of AVI that fell in Atzilut itself. However, their descent was in order to shine from afar in its vessel that stands in Beria, so it would not die entirely and remain without hope. For this reason, it shines in it from afar while it stands in Atzilut, and is regarded as tags over the letters.
